versions.name: Camp Kenya
versions.address: Savage Wilderness Adventure Camp, Sagana, Kirinyaga, Kenya (about 3 hours from Nairobi)

features.note: The Mlima Camp trek culminates in summiting Mt. Kenya.
Karibu Camp, a Trail to First Class track for new Scouts.
Kilele Camp, a high-adventure track with extended whitewater rafting and a night of safari camping.
Three separate camps for youth aged 14 to 20.

versions.summary: Transatlantic Council resident camp held at the Savage Wilderness Adventure Camp near Sagana, Kenya, about three hours from Nairobi on the Tana River. It offers six youth programs spanning a Cub Scout camp, Trail to First Class for new Scouts, Scouts BSA merit badges, a high-adventure track, a Mount Kenya trek, and Sea Scouting, alongside a family program and adult training. Activities include whitewater rafting, kayaking, stand-up paddleboarding, rock climbing, archery, wilderness survival, and a safari adventure.

provenance.notes: Added by hand from the Transatlantic Council camp page; camp-finder never captured this overseas camp, so it was missing from the map. Held at the Savage Wilderness Adventure Camp near Sagana (~3 hours from Nairobi); coordinates geocoded to the Savage Wilderness property. A multi-program winter camp (Cub through Sea Scout, plus a Mount Kenya high-adventure trek). Operational dates and fees are deliberately excluded (they stay on the council site). Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). Some codes are retained from the original camp-finder import and were not re-confirmed by this survey.
